fullDescription: A high-fidelity iOS-inspired dark mode settings interface featuring glassmorphism, native-like UI components, and a carbon-black aesthetic. Designed for utilities, fintech, or IoT applications, it uses high-contrast typography (Inter) and vibrant accent colors (#276EF1, #10B981) against deep neutral backgrounds (#0A0A0A). Key features include bento-style settings cards, custom iOS-style toggle switches, and a blurred glass bottom navigation bar.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated iOS dark-theme settings dashboard with a focus on hierarchy and visual clarity. The design utilizes elevated surfaces, subtle glass materials, and rounded corners (14px) to create a premium, system-level feel. It includes specialized controls for alerts, thresholds, and system configurations.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI with a #0A0A0A carbon black background. Use Inter as the primary font family. Titles should be bold (weight 700-800) at 28px with -0.02em tracking. Section headers should be 13px uppercase with 0.1em tracking in white/40. Cards must have a background of #1A1A1A, 1px border of #2A2A2A, and a border-radius of 16px. Glass components use rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) with 20px backdrop-blur. Primary accent is #276EF1. Toggle switches must mimic iOS: 51x31px, #39393D inactive, #34C759 active, with a white circular thumb.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Fixed header at top. Padding: 56px top, 20px horizontal. Left-aligned: 12px subtitle in white/60 and 28px bold title. Right-aligned: 44px circular profile image with a subtle white/10 border.

### Grouped Settings Sections
Sections start with 32px margin-top. Each section has an uppercase label. List items inside cards are 64px height, using flex layout with 12px gap. Items should be separated by a 1px #2A2A2A border except for the last item. Left side contains a 40px icon container (rounded-xl, 20% opacity of icon color) and two-line text (15px bold, 12px 50% opacity). Right side contains the control element.

### Numerical Input Row
A specialized row within a card for value entry. Features an 11px uppercase label. Input field is 48px height, #0A0A0A background, 1px #2A2A2A border, 12px radius. Content includes a large 18px bold numeric input and a 14px unit label. Beside it, a primary action button (height 48px, white background, black text, bold 14px).

### Glass Info Card
A decorative informational card. Background: white/5 with blur(20px). Features a 48px circular icon with an accent border. Content: 15px bold title and 13px leading-relaxed text. Include a decorative radial gradient (#276EF1 at 10% opacity) blurred by 40px in the bottom-right corner.

### Bottom Navigation Bar
Floating navigation bar pinned to bottom with 34px bottom padding. Outer container: blur(20px), white/5 background, 1px white/10 border, 16px radius. Grid of 3 items. Active state: white/10 background, 1px white/10 border, bold text, colored icon. Inactive state: 50% opacity, medium weight.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### iOS Toggle Switch — A pixel-perfect recreation of the iOS native switch control.
Dimensions: 51px width, 31px height. Background transition from #39393D to #34C759 (400ms duration). Thumb: 27px white circle, 2px offset from edges, box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15). On-click: thumb translates 20px horizontally.

### Icon Background Plates — Soft-colored tiles behind icons to indicate category.
40px x 40px container with 12px (rounded-xl) radius. Background is always the icon's primary color at 20% opacity. Icon size is 20px.
